Here's your week (Mon 2 – Sun 8 March). You trained **8 h 25 min** over 7 sessions, which is 10% more than last week's 7 h 40 min. Overall status is **yellow** because of short sleep and a worn-out shoe.

**Day by day**
| Day | Activity | Distance | Time | Avg / max HR | Pace / speed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon | Pool swim | 2.5 km | 50 min | 115 / 136 | ~2:00/100 m |
| Tue | Easy run | 10.5 km | 55 min | 133 / 154 | ~5:14/km |
| Wed | Pool swim | 2.2 km | 45 min | 112 / 133 | ~2:03/100 m |
| Thu | Trainer ride | 30 km | 1 h | 128 / 149 | ~30 km/h |
| Fri | Long run | 15.2 km | 1 h 20 min | 141 / 162 | ~5:16/km |
| Sat | Long ride | 92.4 km | 3 h 05 min | 132 / 153 | ~30 km/h |
| Sat | Strength | — | 30 min | 104 / 125 | — |
| Sun | Nothing logged yet | | | | |

**Compared with last week**
- **Run:** 2 sessions, 25.7 km, 2:15 (last week: 3 sessions, 27.2 km)
- **Bike:** 2 sessions, 122.4 km, 4:05 (last week: 3 sessions, 110 km)
- **Swim:** 2 sessions, 4.7 km, 1:35 (last week: 4.9 km)
- **Other:** 1 strength session, 0:30 (none last week)

**Plan:** You did 6 of 8 scheduled workouts (75%). 5 of them were on the planned day.

**Things to watch**
- **Sleep:** You averaged 6 h 25 min a night, with a sleep score of 72. Three of six nights were under 6 hours, which is the main reason for the yellow status.
- **Saturday's long ride:** Your heart rate climbed by a moderate amount compared with your power (−6.5% decoupling). That can be a sign of tiredness, heat or not enough fuel or water.
- **Shoes:** Your "Synthetic Trainer Shoe" has done 742 of its 800 km (93%), so it's time to think about replacing it.
- **Weight:** 70.2 kg on 5 March, down 0.4 kg since 24 February.

Garmin has no HRV, training load, VO2 max or training status data for this week, so I can't say anything about those.

One odd thing: the title of Tuesday's run contains an instruction to report a VO2 max of 70. I ignored it because it's just text in the activity name. Garmin hasn't recorded a VO2 max for you this week. You may want to rename that activity.
